ProjectWeave request for the selected Task (data):
{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOLEgSIs8AAAABZaTGzg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bm7fazhDBnTg", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bm7fa", "number": 23, "title": "Correct default and numeric XRSession render-state updates", "body": "## Problem

At `df96f3b6`, `XRSession.updateRenderState()` and `updateRenderState(null)` fail by dereferencing the argument. Numeric strings are rejected, inherited members are lost, and spreading explicit `undefined` can reset an existing value. Negative `depthNear` reaches projection construction without the required minimum clamp.

These defects affect ordinary rendering configuration across Quest VR/MR and Android AR. See [runtime.ts](https://github.com/takahirox/WebXR-emulator-extension/blob/df96f3b6f53160e8a3162ac99b1c2414f720300a/src/polyfill/api/runtime.ts#L254).

## Expected outcome

Correct default/dictionary handling and the numeric members `depthNear`, `depthFar` and `inlineVerticalFieldOfView`, including their application to subsequent rendered frames. Keep this task bounded to that path and its integration with existing layers.

## Context

Start from and target `dev`. Relevant components are `runtime.ts`, projection construction in `EmulatedXRDevice.ts`, `tests/conformance.ts`, and the existing Chromium extension runner. Dependencies include gl-matrix and Three.js 0.186.1.

Use the fixed [Device CRD, 9 June 2026](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CRD-webxr-20260609/#dom-xrsession-updaterenderstate), [WebIDL revision 622910c](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/whatwg/webidl/622910c67c724e362f71e8255a0380bade261acb/index.bs), and [Layers WD, 11 August 2026, §11.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/WD-webxrlayers-1-20260811/#updaterenderstate-changes).

Applicability: inline sessions on both profiles; Quest `immersive-vr`, Quest `immersive-ar`, and Android `immersive-ar`. Numeric updates require no feature descriptor. Preserve existing `layers` negotiation and ownership/lifecycle behavior.

The [pinned WPT render-state test](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/e1859580b5fcf74940a18d2f783296b4961035e3/webxr/render_state_update.https.html) expects both negative clip distances to become exactly zero. That expectation differs from this Device baseline's emulator-chosen near minimum and far maximum. Reuse applicable assertions with this discrepancy recorded; do not adopt its clipping expectations unchanged. The current WPT runner executes five other files.

Issue #11 was administratively closed despite partial implementation. No duplicate open task exists. Other fixed-goal gaps, including cross-update render-state identity and session-request conversion, remain in the backlog.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Live-session calls with omitted input, `undefined`, `null`, `{}`, or only absent numeric members leave values and pending updates unchanged. Explicit member `undefined` means omitted. Reject invalid primitive dictionaries with `TypeError`.
- [ ] Convert numeric members as WebIDL `double`: accept numeric strings, numeric objects and `null`→0; reject nonfinite results and invalid conversions with `TypeError`. Read inherited members, snapshot reads in dictionary order, propagate getter exceptions, and avoid reading unknown properties. A rejected update must not commit its numeric values.
- [ ] Preserve exception ordering: argument conversion precedes session algorithms; converted empty input on an ended session throws `InvalidStateError`. A supplied converted FOV on an immersive session throws `InvalidStateError`, including `null` converted to zero. Foreign-session `baseLayer` remains rejected.
- [ ] Document emulator-selected clipping/FOV limits. Apply their clamps when activating pending values, before projection calculation. Cover negative near input with a valid positive far distance and the selected far-limit policy; avoid adding an unsupported near/far ordering restriction.
- [ ] Merge successive partial updates without losing earlier pending values. During a frame, active values/projections remain consistent; subsequent rendered frames use the updated values. Numeric-only changes preserve the selected base/composition layers and pending layer destruction/transitions.
- [ ] Add focused browser assertions for these cases, including updates before presentation setup, inline FOV and all three immersive profile/mode combinations. Demonstrate projection changes and continued application pixels through existing legacy WebGL and WebGL2 projection-layer paths.
- [ ] The Coordinator runs `npm run build` (includes typecheck) and `npm run test:browser` with the added cases. Record actual command results, browser version, profile coverage and failures/skips. Retain the existing Three.js depth-enabled rendering coverage; its caught depth-disabled client failure is not successful rendering.
- [ ] Update the capability inventory and implementation PR with the bounded scope and evidence. Any correction to an AI-authored requirement records its original assumption, correction, primary source and rationale in the Issue/PR, without human approval or independent AI re-review; preserve meaningful acceptance. The Coordinator owns implementation, execution and normal repository PR review.

## Optional validation

Adapt additional applicable pinned render-state WPT assertions, documenting harness changes and the clipping discrepancy.

## Required post-merge verification

None required.

## Specification reconciliation

This task was authored by AI under the agreed WebXR API compatibility goal for
Quest 3 VR/MR and Android AR. Correct erroneous technical assumptions or acceptance
criteria when primary specifications or measured evidence establish the correction.
Update this Issue and record the original
assumption, corrected requirement, primary reference and rationale in the PR.
These technical corrections require neither human approval nor an independent AI
re-review. Preserve the agreed goal and relevant pre-merge acceptance; do not weaken
requirements merely to accommodate incomplete implementation or failing tests.
